```{r setup}
# library(SABER)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
load_all()

rrs <- read_csv(fs::path_package("SABER", "data","demo_rrs_Om.csv"))

par <- tibble(
  parameter = c("chl", "ag_440", "bbp_550", "h_w", "rb_class_1", "rb_class_2", "rb_class_3", "sd"),
  value = c(2, 0.8, 0.005, 2.5, 0.25, 0.25, 0.5, 0.05),
)

mle <- inversion_optimization(
    rrs = rrs,
    forward_model = "am03",
    error_fct = "log-ll",
    optim_mtd = "auglag",
    init_par = par,
    fixed_par = NULL,
    verbose = T
)

mle
```
